chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from Yahya al-Azraq, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:

I said to him, 'If a man performs Sa'ee between al-Safa and al-Marwa for three circuits or four, then he urinates, can he complete his Sa'ee without wudu?' He said, 'There is no problem, and if he completed his ritual with wudu, it would be more beloved to me.'

key_terms.أَشْوَاطٍ: Circuits or paces of the Sa'ee
key_terms.الصَّفَا: Al-Safa, one of the two hills between which pilgrims walk
key_terms.وَالْمَرْوَةِ: Al-Marwa, the second hill in the Sa'ee ritual

ai.seo_question: Does urinating invalidate the Sa'ee ritual in Hajj or Umrah?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies that minor impurities like urination do not break the validity of Sa'ee, distinguishing it from the stricter requirements of Salah. While completing the ritual without wudu is permissible, the Imam expresses a preference for performing wudu, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on combining legal validity (sahha) with ritual excellence (istihbab). This ruling underscores the flexibility of Hajj rituals while maintaining high standards of spiritual preparation.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Yahya Al Azraq, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The man performs Sa’ee between Al-Safa and Al-Marwa by three circuits or four. Then he urinates. Can he complete his Sa’ee without ablution?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem, and had he completed his ritual with ablution, it would have been more beloved to me<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Hammad ibn ‘Uthaman from Yahya al- Azraq who has said the following: “I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who performs three or four times Sa‘y between al-Safa’ and al-Marwah. He then urinates: if he can perform Sa‘y without wudu’.
He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not harmful but if he can complete the acts with wudu’ is more beloved to me?”
